manifest.scope: External published-case pilot with shared synthetic background; not clinical validation
manifest.selection_rule: SHA256(seed+archive path); first 20 eligible distinct genes/publications/alleles; no ranking-based selection
manifest.background_rule: 399 SHA256(seed+variant ID) selected original background SNVs; six open causal alleles and pilot targets removed
limitations: Public interpretations are accepted from the source; not independently clinically re-curated.
HPO/ClinVar can contain evidence from these publications; no temporal or knowledge-source holdout.
Shared synthetic background is not a full patient exome and limits generalization.
Autosomal single-SNV cases only; unsupported cases are explicitly excluded.
No score thresholds, weights or curated rules are tuned on pilot outcomes.

molecular.clinical_lookup_scope: Uniform lookup of ALL VEP clinical hits across background and pilot targets; no label filtering
molecular.scope: Heuristic prioritization; no calibrated probability, LR or automatic ACMG codes
